purpose: Prove that the ztovalve fixed ball valve camera and exploded component motion can be controlled in Blender from editable deterministic code/data before any homepage hero replacement.

shellSplit.meaning: Open the pressure shell along the pipeline axis.

seatSpread.meaning: Separate seat and seal layers around the ball without rotating them.

stemLift.meaning: Lift stem, packing, bracket, and upper drive along the vertical axis.

lowerDrop.meaning: Drop lower trunnion support and lower bearing parts along the vertical axis.

fastenerSpread.meaning: Spread studs, nuts, washers, springs, pins, and small hardware outward.

ballTurn.meaning: Rotate only the true ball core around the vertical stem axis.

cameraOverride.source: Goal26 keeps the existing camera previs editable, then mixes toward the commercial catalogue hold when the exploded state is active.

acceptanceIntent: The render manifest must identify ztovalve fixed ball valve and must not reference control-valve assets.
The Blender proof must consume the STEP-derived full valve mesh, the existing camera-previs-240.json, and this motion-control.json.
Rendered proof frames must include camera-controlled assembled, exploded, ball-turned, and reassembled/hero-hold states.
The homepage and existing AVIF hero sequence must remain untouched during Goal26 proof.
